title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
author: Stuart Russell & Peter Norvig
description: The standard comprehensive guide to artificial intelligence covering search algorithms, heuristics, knowledge representation, probabilistic reasoning, planning, and reinforcement learning.

title: Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow
author: Aurelien Geron
description: Through a series of recent breakthroughs, deep learning has boosted the entire field of machine learning. Learn to build intelligent systems with Python, scikit-learn, and neural networks.

title: Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning
author: Christopher M. Bishop
description: Comprehensive introduction to pattern recognition and machine learning using Bayesian methods, graphical models, kernel methods, and variational inference.

title: Deep Learning
author: Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio & Aaron Courville
description: An authoritative textbook on deep learning, mathematics for machine learning, deep feedforward networks, convolutional networks, and autoencoders.

title: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS)
author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest & Clifford Stein
description: In-depth reference and university textbook covering a broad spectrum of algorithms, complexity analysis, graph algorithms, dynamic programming, and data structures.

title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
author: Robert C. Martin
description: Even bad code can function, but if code is not clean it can bring a development organization to its knees. Master clean code principles, refactoring, unit testing, and craftsmanship.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
description: The definitive guide to the architecture, reliable storage, streaming, distributed consensus, transactions, and scalability of modern data systems.

title: Python for Data Analysis
author: Wes McKinney
description: Complete instructions for manipulating, processing, cleaning, and crunching datasets in Python using Pandas, NumPy, IPython, and Jupyter.

title: Discrete Mathematics and Its Applications
author: Kenneth H. Rosen
description: Precise and comprehensive treatment of mathematical reasoning, combinatorial analysis, sets, relations, graphs, Boolean algebra, and algorithms.

title: Linear Algebra and Its Applications
author: Gilbert Strang
description: Renowned mathematical foundation covering vector spaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues, singular value decomposition, and computational matrices.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: David Thomas & Andrew Hunt
description: Classic guide covering modern development best practices, engineering discipline, career development, code architecture, and pragmatic execution.

title: Neuromancer
author: William Gibson
description: Seminal cyberpunk novel depicting high-tech cyberspace, matrix artificial intelligences, neural implants, and corporate espionage in Chiba City.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
description: Epic science fiction series detailing psychohistory, predicting the mathematical future of galactic civilizations, and the Galactic Empire.

title: Natural Language Processing with Transformers
author: Lewis Tunstall, Leandro von Werra & Thomas Wolf
description: Build, fine-tune, and train state-of-the-art NLP models using Hugging Face Transformers, BERT, GPT, and modern transformer architectures in PyTorch.

title: Zero to One: Notes on Startups
author: Peter Thiel & Blake Masters
description: Secrets about technology innovation, building monopolies, value creation, startup mechanics, and shaping an exponential technological future.
